response.justification: Bogdan is a solid, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with roughly 15+ years of experience, but his profile is that of a hands-on senior/staff-level developer rather than a Director-level Principal Engineer driving AI strategy. His AI exposure is limited to recent work on MCP tooling and agentic infrastructure, with no track record of building or leading AI products/platforms, advising strategic customers, or shaping cloud/AI strategy at an organizational level.
strengths: Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure systems
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, teaching/workshops)
Long, stable career with 15+ years of hands-on engineering experience
concerns: No evidence of Director-level scope, strategic advisory work, or executive-facing influence
Minimal cloud expertise (only brief AWS CDK mention) and no deep AI/ML specialization or built AI platforms
Career trajectory shows individual contributor/staff-level roles, not principal/strategic leadership positions

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/cloud strategic leadership experience
